I don't know if Ethan's changes have landed, but he was
working on boundary conditions for this when I was in the
office the other day.

The compilers and before/after C++11 vary in how they treat
domain errors in the basic math lib.

The code for acos is pretty simple. If it's really a deep
failure in icc, we'll obviously have to try to code around it.

- Bob
